entities.summary: Blandine Kriegel is a French philosopher, political scientist, and professor. Throughout her career, Kriegel has been president of the Haut Conseil à l'intégration, advisor to Jacques Chirac and member of the Comité consultatif national d'éthique. Kriegel was furthermore assistant to Michel Foucault at the Collège de France.
